title_en: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
title_zh: 多轮强化学习在LLM智能体中真正提升了什么？
summary_en: This paper investigates what multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) actually improves in LLM agents. Using Pass@(K,T) to evaluate across sampling breadth K and interaction depth T, the authors show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets and diminish when budgets tighten. Agentic RL does not uniformly improve single-step decision quality; instead, its benefits concentrate on error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To address budget dependence, they discuss process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL, which varies interaction budgets during training and achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings.
summary_zh: 本文探究多轮智能体强化学习（RL）在LLM智能体中真正提升了什么。通过Pass@(K,T)在采样广度K和交互深度T上评估，作者表明轨迹级RL优势依赖于充足的轮次预算，预算收紧时显著下降。智能体RL并非均匀提升单步决策质量，其优势集中在错误恢复和长程韧性上。为缓解预算依赖，作者初步讨论了过程监督信号的利弊，并提出BudgetMix RL，在训练中变化交互预算，实验表明其在多样执行设置下实现稳健性能。
content_en: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
content_zh: 多轮智能体强化学习（RL）在长时程任务上表现优异，但其性能增益对交互约束仍高度敏感。我们通过 $Pass@(K,T)$ 在采样广度 $K$ 与交互深度 $T$ 上进行评估，结果表明轨迹级 RL 优势依赖于充足的轮次预算，当预算收紧时显著衰减。此外，智能体 RL 并非均匀提升单步决策质量；其优势集中于错误恢复与长时程韧性。为缓解这种预算依赖带来的部署风险，我们对过程监督信号的收益与局限进行了初步讨论，并引入 BudgetMix RL 作为替代方案，在训练过程中变化交互预算。实验表明，BudgetMix RL 在多样化的执行设置下均能取得稳健性能。项目主页：https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
